# CyberHealth v2: Design

**Date:** 2026-09-17
**Status:** Awaiting the family's review
**Database:** `CyberHealth_Sheet_v2.xlsx`, generated by `scripts/make_template_v2.py`. The workbook's README tab and column notes are the authority for every tab and header; this document does not repeat them column by column.

## 1. Why a rebuild

The first version stored medication history as date ranges on rows. Every edit had to keep those ranges meeting exactly, and each rule added to keep them meeting created the next double-dose or missing-medicine bug. Version 2 stores **what a person takes now** and an **append-only log of how it changed**, so no write can create an overlap or a gap.

## 2. Decisions

| Topic | Decision |
|---|---|
| Structure | AppSheet-style: one table per tab, first column is the key, `*_id` columns link tables, fixed values in the Lists tab |
| Ids | Created by the server as a prefix plus 8 random characters (e.g. `RX-7f3k9q2a`). Never reused. Ids typed by hand in the Sheet are also accepted. |
| Medicines, Hospitals, Doctors | Shared family libraries with no person attached. Doctors can work at several hospitals (DoctorHospitals). Doctors have a photo. |
| Prescriptions | One row per person per medicine, holding the current state. `PrescriptionDoses`: one row per time of day with its own amount. |
| History | `PrescriptionChanges` is append-only. `DoseLog` records the amount actually taken at tick time. |
| HN | `HospitalNumbers`: per person per hospital |
| Care team | `CareTeam`: person + doctor + hospital + reason |
| Sharing | The Sharing tab. `View` = read, `Edit` = read and change. A blank `shared_with_user_id` means the whole family. Only the owner changes their own sharing from the app. Sections: `Medicines` (prescriptions, doses, changes, dose log) and `Care team` (HN, care team). |
| Ticking | Owner only. Late ticks for past days are allowed; future days are refused. |
| Emergency card | One table. Every logged-in user can read every card. Without login, cards open without HN. Only the owner edits their own card. |
| Passwords | Start fresh: the admin puts a `reset_code` on each Users row |
| Out of scope | Vitals, Appointments, Vaccinations, Documents, LINE reminders |
| Releases | **Release 1:** all read paths, ticking, login, the emergency card; the Apps Script is complete for these. **Release 2:** every editing screen (medicines, prescriptions, libraries, photos, HN, care team, sharing, change password). |

## 3. Access rules (server-enforced)

A viewer **can read** a person's section when the viewer is that person, or a Sharing row exists for that owner and section whose `shared_with_user_id` is the viewer or blank. A viewer **can edit** when that row's access is `Edit` (or the viewer is the owner).

| Data | Read | Write (release 2 unless noted) |
|---|---|---|
| Users | Own row, plus `user_id`, `display_name` and `role` of every active user. Never hashes or codes. | Only `password_hash`/`reset_code` through the password actions |
| Sharing | Rows where the viewer is the owner or is granted | Owner only |
| Medicines, Hospitals, Doctors, DoctorHospitals | Every logged-in user | Every logged-in user |
| Prescriptions, PrescriptionDoses, PrescriptionChanges, DoseLog | Medicines section read | Edit access; **DoseLog ticks are owner-only (release 1)** |
| HospitalNumbers, CareTeam | Care team section read | Edit access |
| EmergencyCards | Every logged-in user; without login every card with no HN | Owner only (release 1) |
| Settings | Server only | Nobody from the app |

## 4. Scheduling (pure functions)

- **Due on a date:** the prescription is `Active`, `date >= started_on`, and:
  - `Daily` → always
  - `Every N days` → `date >= count_from` and `(date − count_from) mod N == 0`
  - `Weekdays` → the date's weekday is in `weekdays`
  - `As needed` → never (listed separately under "When needed")
- **Today's list:** every due prescription contributes one item per `PrescriptionDoses` row, in the Morning / Noon / Evening / Bedtime section, showing that row's amount and unit.
- **Ticked:** a `DoseLog` row exists for (`prescription_id`, `date`, `time_of_day`) with status `Taken`.
- **Past days in the week strip:** a day counts a prescription only if that prescription's most recent change happened on or before that day. So a change never makes earlier days look missed or doubled. A day before any data shows no dot.
- **A tick writes** `amount_taken` and `unit` from the dose row as it is at that moment.

## 5. API (Apps Script `doPost`)

Every call is `POST {action, token?, …}` → `{ok:true, data}` or `{ok:false, error:{code, message}}`. Codes: `AUTH_REQUIRED`, `AUTH_FAILED`, `LOCKED_OUT`, `FORBIDDEN`, `NOT_DUE`, `FUTURE_DATE`, `BAD_INPUT`, `CONFLICT`, `SERVER`.

**Release 1**
| Action | Notes |
|---|---|
| `listUsers`, `login`, `setPassword`, `logout` | Carried over unchanged: salted SHA-256 records, 5-try friendly lockout plus a hard cap of 50 per 15 minutes, one-time reset codes, 180-day sessions stored as token hashes |
| `publicEmergency` | All active users' cards, no HN, no login |
| `bootstrap` | Everything the viewer may read, in one call: `today`, `me`, `people` (with `can_view`/`can_edit` per section), the libraries, the visible prescriptions with their doses and changes, 60 days of DoseLog, visible HNs and care team, every emergency card (HN only where the viewer can read that person's Care team), `warnings` |
| `tick` | `{prescriptionId, date, timeOfDay}`. Owner only; the prescription must be due. Idempotent. |
| `tickAll` | `{date, timeOfDay, prescriptionIds}`. Ticks only those ids, only if due and not yet ticked. Returns the rows written, so the phone can correct itself. |
| `untick` | Owner only |
| `saveEmergencyCard` | Owner only, whitelisted fields, 500-character cap |

**Release 2** (specified in its own plan): medicine, hospital, doctor, doctor-hospital, HN, care-team, prescription (add, change dose/schedule, stop, restart, delete while untouched) and sharing writes, medicine and doctor photo uploads, change password.

Every write takes the script lock, re-reads what it guards inside the lock, and stamps the audit columns. `SheetDb.append` refuses a field whose column is missing, instead of silently dropping it.

## 6. Screens (release 1)

- **Connect / Log in:** as before (private link or pasted address; tap your name; set or forgot password with a reset code; public emergency card button).
- **Today** (landing): week strip, ring, Morning / Noon / Evening / Bedtime sections, dose rows with the medicine photo, amount, unit and meal tag, tick and tick all (owner only), a read-only banner for family, and a "When needed" list.
- **Meds:** current prescriptions for the selected person. Tap one to see the medicine's photos and details, how to take it (every time of day with its amount), the prescribing doctor with that person's HN at the doctor's hospital, and the change history from `PrescriptionChanges`. Stopped prescriptions sit under "Stopped".
- **Emergency** (centre button): cards with a person switcher; "Edit my card" on your own.
- **Doctors:** the selected person's care team: doctor photo, name, specialty, why they see this person, hospital, HN there, and a call button.
- **More:** logged in as, refresh from the Sheet, Sheet problems, log out; release 2 items shown as "Coming soon".

The visual style (cream and pastels, floating black navigation, pink centre button) carries over.

## 7. What is reused from version 1

| Reused (adapted to v2 names) | Rewritten |
|---|---|
| `js/authcore.js`, the login and session actions | `server/actions.js` data actions and `bootstrap` |
| `js/apiurl.js`, `js/api.js` (private link, mock gate) | `js/schedule.js` (now per prescription and dose row) |
| `apps-script/Data.gs`, `Adapters.gs`, `Code.gs`, `scripts/sync-gs.mjs` | `js/access.js` (sections, View/Edit) |
| `styles.css`, `js/icons.js`, `js/html.js`, `js/format.js` | `js/viewmodel.js`, the Meds, detail and Doctors views |
| Login, connect, Today and emergency views, `js/app.js` structure | `apps-script/CheckSheet.gs` (v2 tables) |
| `sw.js`, manifest, icons, the dev mock and the test harness pattern | The dev sample data and test fixtures (v2 shape) |

Dropped: every phase 1/2 migration, the v1 template, and the date-range logic.

## 8. Deployment

1. The family admin builds a new Google Sheet from `CyberHealth_Sheet_v2.xlsx`, fills it in, and gives each person a `reset_code`.
2. In that Sheet: Extensions → Apps Script. Paste every file from `apps-script/`, run `checkSheet`, and accept the permission prompt.
3. Deploy → New deployment → Web app, execute as Me, access Anyone. Copy the `/exec` address.
4. Build the private link, `https://bewilddata-creator.github.io/Cyberhealth_Mobile/#api=<address>`, and send it privately.
5. Later code changes: Deploy → Manage deployments → Edit → New version, so the address stays the same.

## 9. Testing

- **Node:** the pure scheduling rules and access rules; every action against an in-memory v2 Sheet (visibility per section and access level, ticking rules, late ticks, idempotency, the emergency card with and without HN).
- **Apps Script:** every `apps-script/*.gs` file loaded into one `node:vm` context with fake Google services, driving `doPost` end to end, and `checkSheet` against a correct and a broken v2 Sheet.
- **Browser:** mock mode through the Chrome DevTools Protocol at 390 and 320 px, walking every release 1 screen.
